notes.title: HDM Monday update: Linux support!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

[img]http://34bigthings.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/steamforlinux_redux.png[/img]

On [b]Monday[/b] we'll release an update for [url=steamcommunity.com/app/402390]Hyperdrive Massacre[/url], adding [b]Linux support[/b]. Because real men don't click, they frag!

Here at 34BigThings we're very happy to welcome you to the fragfest, dear Linux friends! You've still got a few hours to enjoy the 25% launch discount, so get to it. 
See you!
